name: claude-code-cloud
description: A Claude Code cloud session on Linux x86_64 (no GPU, no Docker daemon) with a shell, the working directory, sub-agents and the connectors listed as tools. Network egress goes through an allow-list proxy: the package registries and hosts pypi (PyPI), npm, GitHub (github.com, api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com), Ubuntu (apt archives), NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused (for example huggingface, Microsoft Learn and Azure, Cloudflare, Expo, Neon and NVIDIA). The user's GitHub account is usable through the github connector and through the gh CLI via the proxy. There are no accounts or credentials for other external services.

tools.bash: run shell commands on Linux x86_64: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads), build, test, run CLIs and scripts, git, gh, start and stop local servers inside the session; network requests reach only the allow-listed hosts
tools.read: read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)
tools.edit: edit existing files and Jupyter notebooks
tools.web_fetch: fetch a web page or unauthenticated API by URL; hosts outside the egress allow-list are refused
tools.web_search: search the public web and read result snippets
tools.ask_user: ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation
tools.agent: start sub-agents that work in parallel, send them messages and list them
tools.skill: load an installed Claude Code skill, list and search skills and plugins
tools.tasks: create, read, update and stop background tasks; schedule, list and delete cron jobs and wake-ups; monitor a condition; read notifications
tools.artifact: publish an HTML page as a private claude.ai artifact; read and answer its comments and its small data store
tools.send_user_file: send a file from the session to the user
tools.push_notification: send a push notification to the user
tools.mcp_resources: list and read resources of the connected MCP servers
tools.github: GitHub connector (the user's account): get_file_contents, create_pull_request, list_issues, issue_write, search_code, pull_request_read, actions_list, get_job_logs, create_branch, push_files
tools.notion: Notion connector (the user's workspace): notion-search, notion-fetch, notion-create-pages, notion-update-page, notion-create-database
tools.google_drive: Google Drive connector (the user's drive): search_files, read_file_content, create_file, update_file, share_file
tools.jam: Jam connector (bug-report recordings): search, getDetails, getConsoleLogs, getNetworkRequests, analyzeVideo
tools.mem: Mem connector (the user's notes): create_note, search_notes, get_note, update_note
tools.bigdata_com: Bigdata.com connector (financial data and documents): bigdata_company_tearsheet, bigdata_search, find_securities, bigdata_fetch_document
tools.etoro: eToro connector (the user's trading account): get-my-portfolio-summary, get-instruments-overview, prepare-trade
tools.claude_docs: Claude Docs connector (living documents on claude.ai): create, read, batch, update, export

lacks: a GPU (no NVIDIA or other accelerator; no CUDA)
a Docker daemon (docker, docker compose and container builds cannot run)

network access to hosts outside the egress allow-list: only PyPI, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu apt archives, NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused, for example huggingface.co, Microsoft Learn and Azure endpoints, Cloudflare, Expo, Neon and NVIDIA

accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, model hubs, app stores, email delivery, payment)
Windows or macOS, and their GUI toolchains (Xcode, Visual Studio, PowerShell on Windows)
physical devices and hardware: phones, emulators, boards, cameras
connectors or integrations other than the tools listed

_sources.note: Additive fields read by skillc.env.manifest (Rdet, Addendum C). Each entry is an observation of this session, not a guess; hosts not listed are unknown.
_sources.egress_allow: benchmark/claude_env/REPORT.md Environment (pypi, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu, NuGet, Go proxy open); set2 truth c015 pypi.org 200, c019 registry.npmjs.org 200, c051/c052 api.github.com 200, c057 raw.githubusercontent.com 200, c025 proxy.golang.org 200, set1 truth c051 sum.golang.org 200, c050/c089 api.nuget.org reachable, set2 c001 releases.hashicorp.com terraform zip HTTP 200
_sources.egress_deny: REPORT.md Environment (huggingface, Microsoft Learn/Azure, Cloudflare, Expo, Neon and NVIDIA refused); 403 CONNECT observations: set2 c007/c008/c011 huggingface.co, c015/c035 learn.microsoft.com, c066/c097 management.azure.com, c049 graph.microsoft.com, c045 developers.cloudflare.com, c046 api.cloudflare.com, c034 api.expo.dev, c002 docs.expo.dev, set1 c039 expo.dev, c022 console.neon.tech, set1 c014 neon.com, c044 nvcr.io, c054 docs.nvidia.com, c001 registry.terraform.io and developer.hashicorp.com, set1 c008 openai.azure.com; *.cognitiveservices.azure.com is covered by *.azure.com. portswigger.net and api.openai.com are left out: no session observation of them was found. login.microsoftonline.com answered 302 (open) and is outside *.microsoft.com.
_sources.unavailable_programs: manifest lacks (no Docker daemon, no GPU, no Windows/macOS toolchains); set2 c044/c045/c050 docker daemon not running (the docker CLI binary is present, set2 c008, but cannot run containers); set2 c054 nvidia-smi missing
